_what: Copy to private/pii_map.json (gitignored with the documents) and fill in the real values. Each line undoes one substitution made when a key was anonymised: real value as printed on the page -> the pseudonym the key uses.
_how_it_is_applied: To the MODEL'S OUTPUT, before it is compared with a key. Substring replacement, longest real value first, so 'Mr. Jane Doe' becomes 'Mr. Marcus Webb' and '1 Real St #5' becomes '88 Chesterfield Row #5'. Never applied to the keys.
_one_line_per_printed_form: A value printed two ways on two pages needs two lines: '1 Real Street' and '1 Real St' are different strings.
